rule: Every leading token of Lean core's `tactic` syntax category (Init + Lean; complete, nothing filtered by name), bare and with one term argument, run on a fixed battery of synthetic Prop/Nat goals (t2_closers_query.lean) on every installed core toolchain; class per form from the summed outcomes (a token whose runs did not finish within the wall-clock limit on a toolchain is skipped there and on every later toolchain, listed in skipped_hung): closer = closed some goal and never left one open or unchanged or closed through sorry; mixed = closed some and left some open/unchanged; decomposer = never closed, left some open; inert = otherwise. combinators: the five goal-list combinators the T2 spec allows the scheduler to add (rotate_left, any_goals, all_goals, repeat, repeat'), each checked present in the same token table on every toolchain.
